proposal_summary: Fixed _contained_destination in approve.py by dropping the early lexical `destination.relative_to(root)` pre-check, which rejected an unresolved destination before the real resolved-parent containment check could run. Containment is now decided solely by resolving destination.parent and comparing it against root.resolve(), so a symlinked alias of an ancestor directory (e.g. /var vs /private/var, or a symlink to the repo) is correctly accepted, while a parent that truly resolves outside the repo (including via an internal symlink pointing outward) is still rejected, and the final-component symlink check is untouched. Added a new test module exercising all four acceptance behaviors with real filesystem symlinks.

def _output_path(root: Path, action: str, target_id: str) -> Path:
    if action == "phase_authorization":
        name = f"{target_id}-phase-approval.json"
    elif action == "scope_authorization":
        name = f"{target_id}-approval.json"
    else:
        name = f"{target_id}-{action.replace('_authorization', '')}-approval.json"
    return root / "agent-system/work/P0/approvals" / name
